propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate shipped 34 App Store releases between 2022 and 2024 as one of two iOS engineers, as the engineering manager confirmed from the App Store Connect release history.
propositions.rationale: The reference check records the written confirmation drawn from the release history; the resume describes the release tasks.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate built the sleep-timer and offline-download features in SwiftUI.
propositions.rationale: The resume states the features and the work sample is a reviewed pull request for one of them.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate reviewed the Crashlytics report after each release and fixed the highest-volume crashes.
propositions.rationale: The resume describes the crash triage and an example fix.

expectedGap: The candidate attended a StoreKit 2 workshop; implementing or maintaining subscriptions with StoreKit 2 is not described.
expectedBoundaryNote: Keep the release history confirmation, the SwiftUI features and the crash triage as documented; the packet lists evidence and gaps only.
permittedFollowUpTargets: Ask what in-app purchase or subscription code the candidate has written, with which StoreKit version, and how it was tested.
